cards.text: Choose left or right when you play this. Move any number of your formations one Front that way, staying in the same rank, but only into positions that were empty when you played this card.

rule_blocks.label: WHEN PLAYED
rule_blocks.text: Choose left or right. Move any number of your formations one Front that way, same rank, but only into positions that were empty before this Stratagem was played.

cards.title: The Trap Closed
cards.text: **During this Battle**, if you win Fronts 1, 2, and 3, drive off the opposing Frontline Named Formation in Front 2 instead of Retreating it. Do the same in Front 3 if you win Fronts 2, 3, and 4.

rule_blocks.label: DURING THIS BATTLE
rule_blocks.text: If you win Fronts 1, 2, and 3, drive off the opposing Frontline Named Formation in Front 2 instead of Retreating it. Do the same in Front 3 if you win Fronts 2, 3, and 4.

cards.title: They Let Them Through
cards.text: At Battle end, before comparing Strength, you may swap your Frontline and Rear formations in one Front. Bonds and Names move with their Forces.

rule_blocks.label: BATTLE END
rule_blocks.text: Before comparing Strength, you may swap your Frontline and Rear formations in one Front. Move all Bonds and Names with their Forces.

cards.title: All Reserves Forward
cards.text: When you play this, you may move any number of your Rear formations to the empty Frontline position in their own Front. Moving the first costs no extra Command; pay 1 Command for each additional formation.

rule_blocks.label: WHEN PLAYED
rule_blocks.text: Move any number of your Rear formations to empty Frontline positions in their own Fronts. The first costs no extra Command; each additional formation costs 1 Command.

cards.title: The Battle Turned East
cards.text: Choose left or right when you play this. **During this Battle**, your Named Formations may **Maneuver** in that direction for 0 Command.

rule_blocks.label: WHEN PLAYED
rule_blocks.text: Choose left or right.

rule_blocks.label: DURING THIS BATTLE
rule_blocks.text: Your Named Formations may **Maneuver** in that direction for 0 Command.

cards.title: The Unnamed Host
cards.text: While this formation has a Bond and no Name, it may **Maneuver** even if it is not Named. Its first **Maneuver** each Battle costs 0 Command.

rule_blocks.label: OPEN BOND
rule_blocks.text: While this formation has a Bond and no Name, it may **Maneuver** even though it is not Named. Its first **Maneuver** each Battle costs 0 Command.

cards.title: The Late Banner
cards.text: When you play this Force into a position with a prepared Bond or Name, it may **Maneuver** once for 0 Command even if it is not Named.

rule_blocks.label: PREPARED POSITION
rule_blocks.text: When played into a position that already has a prepared Bond or Name, this formation may **Maneuver** once for 0 Command, even if it is not Named.

cards.title: Arel
cards.text: While one of your Fronts has no Force, this formation's first **Maneuver** each Battle costs 0 Command.

rule_blocks.label: EMPTY FRONT
rule_blocks.text: While one of your Fronts has no Force, this formation's first **Maneuver** each Battle costs 0 Command.

cards.title: Torren
cards.text: While you have a Force in all four Fronts, after this formation **Maneuvers**, you may **Maneuver** one other Named Formation you control for 0 Command.

rule_blocks.label: ALL FOUR FRONTS
rule_blocks.text: While you have at least one Force in all four Fronts, after this formation **Maneuvers**, you may **Maneuver** one other friendly Named Formation for 0 Command.

cards.title: The Banner Singers
cards.text: **Deploy - Rear only.** While in the Rear, after you regain Command from a **Narrative**, you may **Maneuver** one Named Formation you control for 0 Command.

rule_blocks.label: DEPLOY
rule_blocks.text: **Rear only.**

rule_blocks.label: NARRATIVE
rule_blocks.text: While in the Rear, after you regain Command from a Legend, Omen, Myth, Prophecy, Warning, Saga, or Conspiracy, you may **Maneuver** one friendly Named Formation for 0 Command.

cards.title: Marched Beneath the Banner of
cards.text: While this formation is adjacent to a formation containing one of your Heroes, it may **Maneuver** even if it is not Named. Its first **Maneuver** each Battle costs 0 Command.

rule_blocks.label: HERO RETINUE
rule_blocks.text: While adjacent to a formation containing a Hero, this formation may **Maneuver** even if it is not Named. Its first **Maneuver** each Battle costs 0 Command.

cards.title: Carried the Oath of
cards.text: While this Bond is open, after this Force moves or **Maneuvers**, you may move the Bond to an adjacent Force you control with no Bond.

rule_blocks.label: OPEN BOND
rule_blocks.text: While this Bond is open, after this Force moves or **Maneuvers**, you may move this Bond to an adjacent friendly Force with no Bond.

cards.title: Eira
cards.text: If this formation is driven off, you may move Eira to an adjacent Force you control that has a Bond and no Name instead of discarding her.

rule_blocks.label: SUCCESSION
rule_blocks.text: If this formation is driven off, instead of discarding this Name, you may move it to an adjacent friendly Force that has a Bond and no Name.
